Specification: This module is a model-checking wrapper for an accountable Tendermint-style protocol trace specification. It declares the protocol state variables used by an underlying Tendermint accountability model, fixes concrete process sets, values, and a finite trace through an INSTANCE of another module, and constrains the proposer mapping through a constant-initialization predicate. The file itself does not define protocol actions or temporal properties directly; instead, it supplies concrete parameters and state declarations for replaying a specific finite scenario involving correct and faulty processes and several proposal/prevote/precommit trace events.
